description.value: The Whistler Sliding Centre is Canada's only Olympic-standard bobsleigh, luge, and skeleton track, purpose-built for the 2010 Winter Games and perched on the side of Blackcomb Mountain above Whistler Village. Run as a non-profit, it welcomes the public for free self-guided interpretive tours and sightseeing year-round, and offers paid summer bobsleigh experiences that let visitors feel the G-forces of an Olympic run. A touring cyclist looking for a unique off-bike experience in Whistler will find this venue genuinely memorable.
